description: Unit tests for the UccServerImpl class, testing connection handling, command reception, reply sending, and resource cleanup in a mock environment.

classes.name: UccServerImplTest
classes.description: Test fixture class for UccServerImpl unit tests, setting up mock objects and common test data.

methods.name: destructor_should_remove_existing_connection
methods.description: Tests that the server properly removes event handlers for an existing client connection upon destruction.

methods.name: new_connection_overwrites_existing_connection
methods.description: Tests that a new incoming connection replaces an existing one, removing previous handlers.

methods.name: receive_command_should_succeed
methods.description: Verifies that a command received from a client is correctly parsed and triggers the command handler.

methods.name: receive_command_should_fail_if_parse_command_fails
methods.description: Checks that if parsing a command fails, the server does not invoke the command handler and cleans up properly.

methods.name: send_reply_should_succeed
methods.description: Ensures that sending a reply to a client works correctly when serialization and send succeed.

methods.name: send_reply_should_fail_if_serialize_reply_fails
methods.description: Verifies that if reply serialization fails, the server does not send and cleans up properly.

methods.name: send_reply_should_fail_with_unknown_socket_fd
methods.description: Tests that sending a reply with an unknown socket file descriptor fails gracefully.
